hunks.baseline: Every one of them was an old fixture who’d ruled Gansu Murim for decades at the very least, and some for more than a century. Besides, ever since the Great Faction War, interfering too much in another sect’s affairs had been taboo.
hunks.sol: Each of them had ruled a part of Gansu Murim for decades at the very least, and some for more than a century. Besides, ever since the Great Faction War, excessive interference in another sect’s affairs had been taboo.

hunks.baseline: And then there was the Black Dragon Demon Gate, standing at the center of it all. What kind of place was it?
hunks.sol: And then there was the Black Dragon Demon Gate at the center of it all.

hunks.baseline: With Sima Gong, the beginning and end of the Black Dragon Demon Gate, speaking so frankly, even the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord had no choice but to back down after briefly letting his anger show.
hunks.sol: With Sima Gong, the beginning and end of the Black Dragon Demon Gate, speaking so bluntly, even the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord had no choice but to back down after briefly letting his anger show.

hunks.baseline: But not the one who had watched it all without so much as twitching an eyebrow.
hunks.sol: But someone else had watched it all without so much as twitching an eyebrow.

hunks.baseline: “Why are you growling so much? You sound like a yellow dog whose food bowl’s been taken away.”
hunks.sol: “Why are you growling? You sound like a yellow dog whose food bowl’s been taken away.”

hunks.baseline: At last, the giant who’d left his mark on the distant history of Murim parted his lips. The icy gleam in Sima Gong’s eyes settled.
hunks.sol: At last, the giant who’d left his mark on Murim’s long history spoke. The icy gleam in Sima Gong’s eyes faded.

hunks.baseline: “I suppose I should. If I can protect my food bowl, I’ll do whatever it takes.”
hunks.sol: “I suppose I should growl. I’ll do it as much as I must to protect my food bowl.”

hunks.baseline: “You mean your own good. The good of a select few who follow you and the Black Dragon Demon Gate.”
hunks.sol: “You mean your own good. The good of the select few who follow you and the Black Dragon Demon Gate.”

hunks.baseline: There were around twenty people here, not counting the Zhongnan Sect and the Black Dragon Demon Gate.
hunks.sol: There were around twenty people here, not counting those from the Zhongnan Sect and the Black Dragon Demon Gate.

hunks.baseline: As Jeok Cheongang looked from one leader of Gansu Murim to the next, an unmistakable sneer curled his lips.
hunks.sol: As he looked from one leader of Gansu Murim to the next, an unmistakable sneer curled his lips.

hunks.baseline: “Come to think of it, isn’t it strange? As I understand it, Gansu has at least fifty sects and martial families, yet not even half of them are here. Ah… were the others already sent to the other fronts?”
hunks.sol: “Come to think of it, isn’t it strange? As I understand it, Gansu has at least fifty sects and martial families, yet not even half of them are here. Ah… were the others already sent to different fronts?”

hunks.baseline: “They’re already carrying out other assignments,” Sima Gong answered in a dry voice.
hunks.sol: “They’re already carrying out other assignments,” Sima Gong answered dryly.

hunks.baseline: “And before you got that agreement, did you lay out all the facts? Or did you go straight to drawing your sword?”
hunks.sol: “And before you got that agreement, did you lay out all the facts? Or did you put a sword to their throats first?”

hunks.baseline: At Jeok Cheongang’s continued string of barbs, Sima Gong let out a short breath. Then, with a calm expression, he began.
hunks.sol: Sima Gong let out a short breath at Jeok Cheongang’s continuing barbs. Then, with a calm expression, he spoke.

hunks.baseline: “We of Gansu Murim will not accept interference from outsiders in this decision, in any form. Even if that interference comes from one of the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families. Or…”
hunks.sol: “We of Gansu Murim will not accept interference from outsiders in this decision, in any form. Even if it comes from the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families. Or…”

hunks.baseline: Sima Gong’s gaze swept past the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord and me, then finally came to a dead stop on Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: Sima Gong’s gaze swept past the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord and me, then stopped on Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: A terrifying old monster who ranked among the top five in the Central Plains in martial arts—and was said to be number one when it came to having a foul temper.
hunks.sol: A terrifying old monster said to rank among the top five in the Central Plains when it came to martial arts—and first when it came to a foul temper.

hunks.baseline: He’d answered Jeok Cheongang in a tone that was downright challenging. No wonder everyone reacted as if they’d been burned.
hunks.sol: He’d answered Jeok Cheongang in a downright challenging tone. No wonder everyone reacted as if they’d been burned.

hunks.baseline: *This is far enough for today.*
hunks.sol: *That’s far enough for today.*

hunks.baseline: Then, at a moment nobody could have expected, I suddenly clapped my hands together with all my strength.
hunks.sol: Then, at a moment nobody expected, I clapped my hands together hard.

hunks.baseline: The sharp sound broke the silence, short and yet seemingly endless. Everyone turned toward me, startled as if they’d just woken from a dream. I blinked at them with perfect composure.
hunks.sol: The sound broke the silence, brief though it had been, yet seemingly endless. Everyone turned toward me as if startled awake from a dream. I blinked at them innocently.

hunks.baseline: With perennial snow on the ground, what damn mosquito?
hunks.sol: With snow that never melted lying all around us, what mosquito?

hunks.baseline: But the point was that my sudden outburst had instantly relieved the tension, which had been plunging toward the abyss.
hunks.sol: But the point was that my sudden clap had instantly broken the tension, which had been spiraling toward disaster.

hunks.baseline: And the two men at the center of it understood the meaning behind my clap at once.
hunks.sol: And the two men at the center of it understood why I’d clapped at once.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve grown some brains, I see. You’ve come a long way.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve grown up some. Come a long way.”

hunks.baseline: At last, Jeok Cheongang’s low voice slipped from between his lips. Sima Gong, as if nothing had happened, respectfully clasped his hands in salute.
hunks.sol: At last, Jeok Cheongang spoke in a low voice. Sima Gong, as if nothing had happened, respectfully clasped his hands in salute.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang looked at me, put on a frown, and spoke.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang looked at me and put on a frown, as though something displeased him.

hunks.baseline: “You certainly do have a long way to go. The road ahead is full of trouble, after all. Isn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “You certainly do have a long way to go. Just thinking about what lies ahead, it’s one obstacle after another. Isn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: “With you here beside us, who needs an army?”
hunks.sol: “With you here alongside us, Senior, what need have we of an army?”

hunks.baseline: Sima Gong put particular emphasis on the word *beside*, then suddenly lifted his head and looked at me.
hunks.sol: Sima Gong put particular emphasis on *alongside us*, then lifted his head and looked at me.

hunks.baseline: “You truly have an exceptionally perceptive Disciple.”
hunks.sol: “You truly have a perceptive Disciple.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know about perceptive. He’s got a good sense for reading a room.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know about perceptive. He’s good at reading a room.”

hunks.baseline: “Remarkable martial prowess, and a mind that sees several moves ahead. He’s a blessing to all Murim. My son ought to have spent more time watching and learning from you while he had the chance… What do you think of him?”
hunks.sol: “With his remarkable martial prowess and shrewd mind, he’s a blessing to all Murim. My son ought to have watched and learned more from you while he had the chance… What did you think of him?”

hunks.baseline: Over his shoulder, I saw Sama Pyo standing there without a trace of expression. It made me wonder if Sima Gong meant he’d raised his son as a father—or if he sounded more like a craftsman talking about a piece he’d made.
hunks.sol: Over his shoulder, I saw Sama Pyo standing there without a trace of expression. It struck me that Sima Gong sounded less like a father talking about raising his son than a craftsman talking about a piece he’d made.

hunks.baseline: “So, you don’t plan to change your current judgment?”
hunks.sol: “So, you don’t plan to change your decision?”

hunks.baseline: Maybe. Was this really what Gansu Murim wanted?
hunks.sol: Maybe. But was this really what Gansu Murim wanted?

hunks.baseline: *Inventory.*
hunks.sol: The Inventory.

hunks.baseline: I mentally felt for an item stowed somewhere in that bottomless, pitch-black subspace.
hunks.sol: Somewhere in that bottomless, pitch-black subspace was an item I found myself turning over in my mind.

hunks.baseline: “Then let’s do that.”
hunks.sol: “Then let’s do it your way.”

hunks.baseline: The surprised question came from neither Jeok Cheongang, who was frowning, nor Sima Gong.
hunks.sol: The startled question came from neither Jeok Cheongang, who was frowning, nor Sima Gong.

hunks.baseline: It was the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord. He stared at me with wide eyes.
hunks.sol: It was the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord. The Sect Leader of the Zhongnan Sect stared at me with wide eyes.

hunks.baseline: Right then, before I could answer, two other voices cut the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord off.
hunks.sol: Before I could answer, two other voices cut him off.

hunks.baseline: “Every group has its own rules, wherever you go. Just as our Zhongnan does.”
hunks.sol: “Everywhere you go, people have their own rules. Our Zhongnan is no different.”

hunks.baseline: “Senior Brother is right. Junior Brother, as the Sect Leader of our sect, remember once more how you should conduct yourself.”
hunks.sol: “Eldest Senior Brother is right. Junior Brother, remember how you ought to conduct yourself as our sect’s Sect Leader.”

hunks.baseline: Those were the two.
hunks.sol: Those were the two who had spoken.

hunks.baseline: After his Senior Brothers spoke in turn, the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord muttered as though groaning.
hunks.sol: After hearing his Senior Brothers speak in turn, the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord muttered as though groaning.

hunks.baseline: “Senior Brothers. But how can we let this happen?”
hunks.sol: “Senior Brothers. But how can we…”

hunks.baseline: “We can well imagine how you feel, Sect Leader. But we must tell you that further discord may jeopardize the greater cause.”
hunks.sol: “We understand how you feel, Sect Leader. But further discord could jeopardize what we’re trying to accomplish.”

hunks.baseline: Sima Gong calmly but firmly cut off the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord before he could continue. Then he surveyed the room and went on.
hunks.sol: Sima Gong calmly but firmly cut him off. Then he surveyed the room and went on.

hunks.baseline: “I hope everyone will remember this. We are allies united beneath the Murim Alliance’s banner, and we must not create discord over a decision that has already been made. Much less…”
hunks.sol: “I hope everyone will remember this. We are allies united beneath the Murim Alliance’s banner. There should be no discord over a decision that has already been made. And…”

hunks.baseline: Sima Gong’s deeply lowered gaze suddenly came to rest on me.
hunks.sol: His gaze came to rest on me.

hunks.baseline: “Should anyone act unilaterally without seeking everyone’s agreement. Wouldn’t you say?”
hunks.sol: “Acting alone without seeking everyone’s agreement is even less acceptable. Wouldn’t you say?”

hunks.baseline: At the sudden drop in his voice, Jeok Cheongang’s eyebrow twitched. But I discreetly tugged at his sleeve from where Sima Gong couldn’t see, then shrugged.
hunks.sol: At the sudden drop in his voice, Jeok Cheongang’s eyebrow twitched. I discreetly tugged at his sleeve where Sima Gong couldn’t see, then shrugged.

hunks.baseline: As the leaders of Gansu Murim filed out, they kept stealing anxious glances at Jeok Cheongang. He stayed silent, his face like someone suffering from a particularly nasty case of constipation.
hunks.sol: As the leaders of Gansu Murim filed out, they kept stealing anxious glances at Jeok Cheongang. He stayed silent, wearing the expression of someone suffering from a particularly nasty case of constipation.

hunks.baseline: Only after we’d escaped the eyes of everyone around us, leaving just the two of us, did he finally speak.
hunks.sol: Only after we were out of everyone’s sight and alone together did he finally speak.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t change the subject. You had something in mind, or you wouldn’t have tried so hard to hold this old man back.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t dodge the question. You had something in mind, or you wouldn’t have tried so hard to hold this old man back.”

hunks.baseline: My words caught in my throat for a moment. I let out a deep sigh, then resumed walking.
hunks.sol: I was at a loss for words. After a deep sigh, I started walking again.

hunks.baseline: At my quiet words, Jeok Cheongang’s expression hardened too.
hunks.sol: At my quiet words, Jeok Cheongang’s expression hardened.

hunks.baseline: His voice grew louder as he reached the end of the sentence. I gave a small shake of my head.
hunks.sol: His voice rose toward the end. I gave a small shake of my head.

hunks.baseline: “Tell me everything. Don’t leave anything out.”
hunks.sol: “Tell me more. Don’t leave anything out.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you remember how Elder Nam suddenly came to see me a day ago and said he had something to discuss?”
hunks.sol: “Do you remember how Elder Nam came to see me out of the blue a day ago and said he had something to discuss?”

hunks.baseline: I’d always discussed most important matters with Jeok Cheongang, and sometimes we’d even found the answer together.
hunks.sol: I’d always discussed most important matters with Jeok Cheongang, and sometimes found the answer by doing so.

hunks.baseline: Namho had approached me suddenly and, speaking in a hushed voice, told me something I hadn’t expected.
hunks.sol: Namho had approached me out of the blue and, speaking in a hushed voice, told me something I hadn’t expected.

hunks.baseline: *“Just before we left the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I went looking for Sama Pyo because he was missing. Taishan was with him.”*
hunks.sol: *“Just before we left the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I noticed Sama Pyo was missing and went looking for him. Taishan was with him.”*

hunks.baseline: *“There wasn’t a trace of anything, but I’m certain Sama Pyo was burning a missive.”*
hunks.sol: *“There wasn’t a trace left, but I’m certain Sama Pyo was burning a missive.”*

hunks.baseline: No—by the time Sama Pyo had tried to hide it, it had already been more than an ordinary missive.
hunks.sol: No—once Sama Pyo had tried to hide it, it was no ordinary missive.
